As a senior in high school who's got no idea where to go in life, what advice do you have? Where did you go wrong? Did you go wrong?

Also, what specifically do you hate?

Everyone says, "Do what you love". They are correct, but the problem is, they don't tell you how. This is what I have learned. Find your purpose, whatever it is. Also, define the vision of what you want your life to be. Most successful people that are happy (the minority) do purposeful work.

Another plus is to define a vision for your life. Where do you want to be in 10-20-50 years. There is an amazing and painful exercise that can help you there. Write the eulogy that your children, not even born yet, are going to read at your funeral. What will come out of that experience is an amazing amount of reflection, tears, and a better idea of who you are and what your vision is. A vision can change, but once you have one, everything you do supports that vision or hurts it.

For example my vision is that on my 80th birthday, I am in a warm room with all of my family and grandchildren (I have none now). There is snow outside, there is a fire in the fireplace. We are comfortable, we are safe, the room is filled with love. - So what do I need to do to support that vision. I need to eat healthy, make sure I raise my family with love etc. Those are insanely powerful exercises that I don't know if I could appreciate in high school, but if you can, they will help you greatly.

First off, everything is going to be ok.

Really, it absolutely is. Even if you fuck EVERYTHING up from here on out and the business crashes and burns, you've still achieved something incredible.

Pain and misery can certainly change you, but only if you let them. I'm guessing what you're experiencing right now is less pain and misery, and more fear of failure and anxiety that you're now responsible for the welfare of your employees. That fear is what is weakening you, and causing the anxiety that is making you miserable.

Let me tell you something. You could die right now.

BAM.

Dead.

Game over. Business collapses. Your family destitute. End of your world.

The only reason you're reading this right now is because God (or the universe, or whomever your higher power is) decided to give you this day. You don't have tomorrow. You only have right now. And right now, you're sitting in front of your computer screen, looking for someone or something online to help you forget about your fear and stress over having this responsibility that you thought you were prepared for. Tomorrow doesn't exist, but you're letting your fear of it crowd out anything good about today.

Go take a walk. Seriously - get up from the screen or put your phone away and go walk. Find a place that's wooded or a park or whatever. Hell, even walking through the slums outside will do it depending on where you're at. Do not go into a bar, do not get a drink or do anything chemical. Walk until your thoughts stop spinning and you're out of breath and your legs start hurting. Yes, you can go ahead and take the time to do this - you're the fucking CEO.

When you've exhausted yourself, close your eyes and listen. Listen to the noises around you. Smell the smells. Connect with your body. Feel your legs hurting, your lungs breathless, your heart pumping.

And know that it could stop at any minute. BAM!

...but it keeps going on.

THAT'S what really matters. And if you believe in God or the universe or whatever higher power you have, however you believe, say thanks. Because as long as you're alive, everything HAS worked out ok. And it will until it doesn't.

And you know what, you have absolutely no control over that. The only thing you have control of is whether you will savor your life, or if you will let fear ruin it.

Good luck, and God bless... :)
